title: Two funded PhD positions in catchment biogeochemistry

add_special_note.heading: Applications open
add_special_note.text: Two fully funded PhD positions (four years) on catchment carbon and nutrient dynamics. Start date flexible; applications close 15 January.

add_paragraph.heading: The projects
add_paragraph.text: One position focuses on dissolved organic matter export from forested catchments; the other on sediment-bound phosphorus in agricultural streams. Both combine field campaigns with laboratory analysis and a substantial modelling component.

add_list.heading: What we look for
add_items_to_list: A master's degree in environmental science, chemistry, geography or a related field.
Evidence of independent fieldwork or laboratory work.
Comfort with quantitative analysis; willingness to learn the rest.
Good written English and a habit of keeping notes.

add_paragraph.heading: How to apply
add_paragraph.text: Send a single PDF containing a two-page CV, a one-page statement of interest and the names of two referees. There is no application form. Shortlisted candidates are interviewed online within three weeks.

add_special_note.heading: Equal opportunity
add_special_note.text: We particularly welcome applications from candidates who are underrepresented in the environmental sciences. Part-time arrangements are possible for both posts.
